//: Type-checks test files. Run as the second half of `pnpm typecheck`.
//why: Nothing type-checked a test file until this existed. `tsconfig.typecheck.json` reaches only `packages/*/src`, and excludes test files on top of that — so a test could import a type that does not exist and stay green forever, because vitest's esbuild transform strips types without checking them. That is exactly what happened: admin-types' own test kept importing `type AdminCollectionConfig` for the whole refactor, after the type had been deliberately deleted, and the first thing to notice was a Docker build in an end-to-end run.
//scope: Only the packages listed below, because the other 16 test directories carry 1493 pre-existing errors between them — worst are server-postgres (808), client (241), common (124) and server (111). Those are real debt and unrelated to the admin/BaaS split; fixing a package's test types is what earns it a line here. `packages/types/__tests__` is deliberately absent and should stay absent: the `bivariance/` files are probes that assert generics are *not* assignable, so they are supposed to error.
